name: 39702 · Columbus, MS
findings: ZIP 39702 (Columbus) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39702 (Columbus) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39702 (Columbus) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
